scope: Bounded differential review of the Even bootloader SYSPLL against the pinned AmbiqSuite 5.1.0 am_hal_syspll.c. Not workflow coverage, not hardware proof.

build_copy.change: am_hal_syspll_mux_select compiled out (#if 0); the stock bootloader links no am_hal_sysctrl_clkmuxrst_clkneeded_update

rea.finding: Decompiles to am_hal_syspll_configure: handle check (bInit|magic 0x504C30), bEnable->7, RefDiv<64, integer FBDIV 4..960 / fraction 10..96, PostDiv<8 and PostDiv2<=PostDiv1, PLLCTL0 VCOSELECT/FREFSEL/DSMPD, PLLDIV0 FRAC, PLLDIV1 FBDIV/REFDIV/POSTDIV1/2, fref update call 0x41ac92, DACPD/FOUT* writes.

method.emulator: Unicorn 2.1.4 (A-class Thumb core; M-profile PRIMASK MRS/MSR/CPSID emulated by an instruction hook)
method.candidate: Same C as the bootloader build (generated am_hal_syspll.c, syspll_hal_bindings.c, clock_pll_rounding.c, clock_pll_mod.c) compiled with the g2-apollo-bootloader-6 profile but -mcpu=cortex-m4 -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16 so the emulator decodes it (clang emits VSEL for M55). Delay stubs replace am_hal_delay_us; stock 0x41d1c0 is short-circuited.
method.abi_note: Stock am_hal_syspll_config_generate takes its floats in s0/s1 (IAR); the build passes them in r1/r2 (softfp). The test feeds each side its own convention.
method.compared: return value; 12-byte am_hal_syspll_config_t output; handle word; PLLCTL0/PLLDIV0/PLLDIV1/HALSTATES/D2ASPARE final values; configure MMIO write sequence

mutant_check: PostDiv2 > PostDiv1 changed to >= in the candidate: 25 of 600 configure cases mismatch.
limitations: Emulated MMIO is plain RAM; lock and power settling are not modelled.
am_hal_syspll_initialize (0x4272ac) and am_hal_pwrctrl_syspll_enable (0x41ca5c) were compared by reading, not executed.

build_source_update.note: The bootloader now builds am_hal_syspll.c from AmbiqSuite SDK 5.0.0 (third-party/upstream/ambiqhal-apollo510-sdk5.0.0 @ 392042e), the SDK the bootloader was identified as using (bootloader-hal-upstream-review.json). The 5.0.0 file differs from the 5.1.0 one compared here only in comments and the revision line.

final_image_rerun.harness: build/boot-hal-diff/diff_syspll.py (seed 0x5150): the earlier cases on the IT-safe base harness, running the final image's cortex-m55 code (VSEL emulated) instead of a cortex-m4 recompile
final_image_rerun.note: config_generate floats go in s0/s1 on the stock (hard-float) side and r1/r2 on the softfp build, matching each image's own callers.
